work.title: Untitled (Planes and Discs) 3
work.description: Multiple warplane silhouettes in side profile and top-down view are distributed across a densely layered surface alongside scattered compact discs and concentric target rings. Fragmented paper in ochre, magenta, and black overlaps with ink lines and paint splatter across a wide horizontal format.
work.composition: Dense horizontal scatter of planes and discs
